en: Fixed a case where deny and ask rules, hook matchers and `disallowedTools` entries written with a claude.ai connector's terminal name (`mcp__claude_ai_Slack`) were ignored in Claude Desktop (takes effect once Claude Desktop includes this version)
zh: 修复了以下问题：在 Claude Desktop 中，使用 claude.ai connector 的终端名称（`mcp__claude_ai_Slack`）编写的 deny 和 ask 规则、hook 匹配器以及 `disallowedTools` 条目会被忽略（Claude Desktop 包含此版本后生效）
